signIn.title: Welcome back
signIn.body: Sign in to pick up where the team left off.
signIn.bodyReturning: You'll go straight back to where you were.
signIn.remember: Keep me signed in on this device
signIn.unreachable: We couldn't reach sign-in just now. Try again.
signIn.footnote: New here? Ask your workspace admin for an invitation.

error.expired: That sign-in attempt expired. Start again.
error.exchange_failed: We couldn't complete sign-in. Try again.
error.ended: Your session ended. Sign in again to pick up where you were.

sessionExpired.title: You've been signed out
sessionExpired.body: Your session ended. Sign in again to pick up where you left off.

scale.headline: Customers get answers while your team sleeps.
scale.support: GOTCHA answers from what your business knows, and hands your team whatever it can't.

actions.headline: Every order it touches leaves a trace you can open.
actions.support: Which order, what it did, and for whom - written down as it happens.

team.headline: Everything GOTCHA does is written down.
team.support: Which tool it used, on whose behalf, and when - on one page, in plain words.

why.headline: A refund is real money. So is a customer list.
why.support: Everyone who can act on a customer's behalf signs in twice. It costs a few seconds, and it is the reason an admin can sleep.

behind.headline: The actions behind this code can move money.
behind.support: Refunds, cancellations, discounts, payout details. All of them are one code away, and every use of them is logged.

cost.headline: A few seconds, rarely.
cost.support: This device stays trusted, so this is not a code you will be asked for often.

secondFactor.status: Two-step is required by your workspace

secondFactor.title: One more step
secondFactor.continuing: Taking you to your sign-in provider.

code.label: Code from your authenticator app
code.hint: It submits itself the moment the last digit lands.

recovery.label: Recovery code
recovery.hint: One of the codes you saved when you set up two-step.

method.webauthn: Use your security key - continues at your sign-in provider
method.duo: Approve with Duo - continues at your sign-in provider
method.sms: Get a code by SMS - continues at your sign-in provider
method.other: Another method - continues at your sign-in provider

recover.title: Reset your password
recover.lede: Enter the address you sign in with and we will send you a link to set a new password.
recover.unreachable: We could not reach the sign-in service. Try once more.

editorial.headline: A password is the one thing we cannot tell you.
editorial.support: We can only send a link to the address already on the account. Nobody here can read your password, and nobody can set one for you.

recover.sentBody: If {email} has an account here, a link to set a new password is on its way. It expires shortly, so use it soon.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.lede: Continue to choose a new password for your account.

setup.title: Set your password
setup.lede: Continue to set the password for your new account.
setup.doneBody: From now on, you sign in with it.

reset.terms: I have read and agree to the <terms>Terms of Service</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>

rules.title: Your password needs:
rules.leaked: Not a password known from a data leak. This is checked when you save.

problem.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
problem.rules: The password does not meet every rule above yet.
problem.weak: This password is too easy to guess. Add another word or two.
problem.leaked: This password has appeared in a data leak. Choose a different one.
problem.unreachable: We could not reach the sign-in service. What you typed is still here. Try once more.

hasPassword.title: You already have a password
hasPassword.body: The password for this account is already set. Sign in with it.

expired.title: This link has expired or was already used
expired.body: A link like this works once, and only for a short time. Ask for a new one and use it soon.
expired.setupBody: Invites and setup links work once, and only for a short time. Ask whoever invited you to send a new one.

malformed.title: This link is incomplete
malformed.body: Part of it may be missing. Open it again from the email, or ask for a new one.
malformed.setupBody: Part of it may be missing. Open it again from the email, or ask whoever invited you for a new one.

unexpected.title: We could not finish this here
unexpected.body: Something in this step is set up differently from what this page expects. Ask for a new link, and if it happens again, contact support.
unexpected.setupBody: Something in this step is set up differently from what this page expects. Ask whoever invited you for a new link, and if it happens again, contact support.

join.title: Join <workspace></workspace>
join.lede: Set up your account to start working with the team.
join.name: Your name
join.emailFixed: This invitation is for this address.
join.passwordNext: You choose your password on the next screen, on our secure sign-in service.
join.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
join.joinedBody: You already have a password with us. Sign in with it to open the workspace.

problem.invalid: This invitation can no longer be used. Ask whoever invited you to send a new one.
problem.already_member: That address is already a member of this workspace. Sign in instead.
problem.invalid_input: Check your name and email address.
problem.failed: That did not go through. Try again in a moment.
problem.used: This invitation was already used. If that was you, sign in.
problem.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask whoever invited you to send a new one.

missing.title: This link is incomplete
missing.body: The invitation link is missing its code. Open it again from the email, or ask whoever invited you for a new one.

invalid.title: This invitation cannot be used
invalid.body: This link is not a valid invitation. Open the whole link from the email, or ask whoever invited you for a new one.

unreachable.title: We could not read this invitation
unreachable.body: Your link may well be fine. This is on our side, and trying again in a minute usually works.

editorial.headline: Your team saved you a seat.
editorial.support: Joining adds you to the workspace. You choose your own password on our sign-in service, and nobody here can see it.

closed.headline: Each invitation works once.
closed.support: An invitation opens the workspace for one person, for a limited time. Whoever invited you can send a new one.

used.title: This invitation was already used
used.body: Someone accepted it already. If that was you, sign in. If not, ask whoever invited you to send a new one.

expired.title: This invitation has expired
expired.body: Invitations work for a limited time. Ask whoever invited you to send a new one.

expired.title: That link has expired
expired.body: Setup links stop working after a while. Ask for a new one and it will be in your inbox in a moment.

revoked.title: That link was replaced
revoked.body: A newer setup link was sent to you, so this older one stopped working. Check your inbox for the most recent email, or ask for another.

invalid.title: That link is not valid
invalid.body: It may have been copied incompletely. Try clicking the link in your email again rather than pasting it.

identity_missing.title: We could not find your account
identity_missing.body: Ask whoever invited you to send a fresh invitation.

idp_unavailable.title: Our sign-in service did not answer
idp_unavailable.body: Your link is fine. This is on our side, and trying again in a minute usually works.

setupLink.signIn: Already set a password? Sign in

sent.title: Check your inbox
sent.body: A new setup link is on its way. It replaces every earlier link.
sent.nothing: Nothing arrived? Look in spam, then ask whoever invited you to resend it.

problem.rate_limited: You have asked for several new links in a short time. Wait a while, then try again.
problem.failed: Could not send a new link. Try again in a minute.

editorial.headline: A link that went stale is easy to replace.
editorial.support: You set your password on our sign-in service, through a link only you receive. Nobody here can see it.

editorial.headline: Delete your GOTCHA account
editorial.support: Ask for it here, even without the app. We confirm by email first.

accountDeletion.title: Delete your GOTCHA account
accountDeletion.lede: Type the email address you sign in with. We send a link to confirm; nothing is deleted until you press it.

policy.deleted: What is deleted: (policy text pending confirmation)
policy.kept: What is kept, and for how long: (policy text pending confirmation)

sent.title: Check your email
sent.body: If an account uses this address, we sent it a link to confirm the deletion. The link works once, for {hours} hours.

refusal.BAD_EMAIL: That doesn’t look like an email address.
refusal.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests for now. Try again in a while.
refusal.failed: It didn’t go through. Try again.

confirm.title: Confirm the deletion
confirm.lede: Pressing the button asks us to delete this GOTCHA account. Nothing happens until you press it.
confirm.failed: It didn’t go through. Try again.

done.title: Deletion confirmed
done.by: Your account will be deleted by {date}.
done.soon: Your account will be deleted soon.
done.cancel: Changed your mind: (policy text pending confirmation)

BAD_TOKEN.title: This link doesn’t work
BAD_TOKEN.body: It may be incomplete. Ask for a new one.

TOKEN_EXPIRED.title: This link has expired
TOKEN_EXPIRED.body: Links work for {hours} hours. Ask for a new one.

ALREADY_CONFIRMED.title: Already confirmed
ALREADY_CONFIRMED.body: This deletion was confirmed before. There is nothing more to do.
